label: Bible Study
prompt: The fear of the LORD is the _____ of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verse: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
note: A close cousin of the book's motto — wisdom starts with reverence for the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be _____.
verse: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
note: Asketh, seeketh, knocketh — and no knock in this verse goes unanswered. Every one finds the door opened.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a _____; and Moses fled from before it.
verse: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
note: Moses' shepherd rod hit the ground as a serpent — and the future deliverer of Israel ran from it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my _____ with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
verse: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
note: Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders: chains awaited in Jerusalem, and he only cared about finishing well.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah _____ and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
verse: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
note: Fire and 'brimstone' on Sodom and Gomorrah — the scene behind Jesus' shortest warning: 'Remember Lot's wife' (Luke 17:32).
